title: Indeed Job Scraper

searchQuery.title: Job Search Query
searchQuery.description: Use this field when the user provides a job title, skill, keyword, or role to search for (e.g. 'software engineer', 'nurse', 'marketing manager', 'data analyst'). Use startUrls instead when the user provides a direct Indeed.com search URL.
searchQuery.sectionDescription: Define what jobs to search for. Use either a keyword search query OR direct Indeed URLs — not both at once.

location.title: Location
location.description: City, state, ZIP code, or 'Remote' to filter jobs geographically (e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'New York', 'Remote', '10001'). Leave empty to search all locations.

startUrls.title: Direct Indeed URLs
startUrls.description: Use this field when the user provides specific Indeed.com job search URLs (e.g. https://www.indeed.com/jobs?q=nurse&l=Chicago). Do NOT use this when the user provides keywords or a role name — use searchQuery for that instead.

maxResults.title: Maximum Results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of job listings to scrape and return. Each result costs $0.002 (= $2 per 1,000 jobs). Default is 50. VibeLeads scope: qualify companies first. Optional contact extraction stays disabled in discovery; enable only a reviewed, relevant contact stage for named qualified businesses under the contact-use gate. Provider bounds are not recommended volumes or permission.

country.title: Country Domain
country.description: Which Indeed country site to scrape. Use 'www' for United States (default). Change for country-specific job markets.

proxyConfiguration.title: Restricted access control
proxyConfiguration.description: VibeLeads restriction: enablement is unsupported. Verify a documented disabled/direct/public mode and actual build behavior before execution; otherwise decline this route. See the source access gate.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Proxy and performance settings. Safe to leave as defaults.

x-vibeleads-execution-review: required; schema inspection is not execution permission
x-vibeleads-contact-use-review: required; company discovery and contact stages are distinct
